ImageDescription.value: Berlin, Germany: Theater am Kurfürstendamm Berlin-Charlottenburg, Kurfürstendamm 208-209 Originally built 1904-1905. 1908 installation of a theatre hall. 1921-1923 installation of a theatre proper. 1925 rebuilding by Oskar Kaufmann. 1930-1931 major rebuilding by Oskar Kaufmann for the theatre director, Max Reinhardt. 1936 rebuilding by Carl Cramer. Damaged in World War II. After 1945, restoration and auditorium simplification by Helmut Remmelmann and Fritz Gaulke. Subsequently used by the "Freie Volksbühne" company. 1971 exterior rebuilding by Sigrid Kressmann-Zschach, incorporating the theatre hall in the new "Kurfürstendamm-Karree" complex. Used as a private theatre for light drama and comedy performances.
